note: Style records for the hands that predate `export const STYLE`. When a module grows its own STYLE export the scanned record wins on an id collision, and once every entry here has one, this file can go.

styles.name: Pencil & watercolour
styles.medium: graphite and pan watercolour on cold-press: washes that never quite fill their outline, form shaded toward one light, graphite over the paint

styles.name: Marker comic
styles.medium: alcohol-marker cel fills with a hard shadow edge under one heavy contour that thickens away from the light
styles.hero: a Sanke koi turning under lily pads

styles.name: Ballpoint sketch
styles.medium: one blue ballpoint on cream cartridge, near-constant weight; tone only from where the hatching sits, plus the blob where a firm stroke stops
styles.hero: a pocket watch lying on a table

styles.name: Crayon
styles.medium: wax crayon on toothed paper: back-and-forth scribble fills that skip the valleys, a darker crayon on the shade side, a white one burnishing the highlight, a fat contour gone over twice

styles.name: Ink & line-wash
styles.medium: wet washes first that flood past the line and settle along each shape's bottom edge, backruns, then a flexible nib thick on the press and hair-thin on the lift

styles.name: Chalkboard
styles.medium: side-of-the-chalk scumble on a slate board, lit limbs worked twice, every stroke broken by the board's tooth with dust either side, ghosts of old lessons

styles.name: Cut-paper collage
styles.medium: zero drawn lines: torn pieces with a white fibrous edge, scissor pieces crisp, each lifting a soft shadow off the piece below

styles.name: Risograph
styles.medium: soy ink, one layer per drum multiplied through its own registration offset; every other colour an overprint, tone a halftone screen per ink angle, white is bare paper

styles.name: Single-line engraving
styles.medium: one unbroken engraved line whose width follows a procedural tone field: the whole picture is a single stroke
styles.hero: a moon spiralled out of one line

styles.name: Storybook pencil + watercolour
styles.medium: storybook graphite and gentle pan watercolour, drawn for a recurring character
styles.hero: Bit, waving, in storybook pencil and watercolour

styles.name: Cyanotype blueprint
styles.medium: ruling pen in white ink on Prussian-blue cyanotype stock: draftTooth and blueMottle tiles, inkGroup halos, inclined gothic lettering
styles.hero: the clockwork butterfly, the blueprint act of the worked film
